words.headline: Sunday Chill Moves Indoors: No-Heat Calls Jump to 2,526
words.blurb: New Yorkers reported 2,526 cases of no heat or hot water on a 38-degree Sunday morning, well above the usual 1,528. Noise took the day off, dropping to 2,483 calls from a typical 3,099.
words.card_line: Quiet streets, cold radiators, warm socks.

boroughs.Bronx: No heat led the borough with 785 reports, and the radiators stayed quiet too.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled with 1,112 reports; the curb remains Brooklyn's hottest real estate.
boroughs.Manhattan: No heat topped the list at 647, with noise close behind at 585.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars led with 846 reports as driveways and hydrants stayed contested.
boroughs.Staten Island: Parking wars came out on top with 103 reports on a fairly calm Sunday.

extras.text: NYPD answered 2,327 noise complaints. 1,027 times they found nothing going on when they got there.
195 times officers couldn't get inside. 11 noise calls ended with a ticket.

rare_finds.name: Stoop line stand: unlicensed
